notes.problem: A flat sine-ripple plane, a flat near bank band, a thin field strip, a mannequin on the far bank.
notes.fix: Camera at the near lip with the modelled bank in the lower third, a noise normal reflecting the warm band, remove the figure.

notes.problem: The drowned lath is a 10 px speck, sine-stripe water, a flat near bank slab.
notes.fix: Bring the lath to 6 to 8 m from the camera at a 0.8 m eye, noise ripple with a Fresnel reflection of the warm band, a sloped wet near bank.

notes.problem: Ruled ripples, a hard straight edge onto an untextured slab, a 10 px drowned lath, a mannequin on the far bank.
notes.fix: Model the near bank as a sloped clay cut with a damp band, move the lath into the near third, drop the far figure.

notes.problem: A sprite hill, a clipped cedar branch, a banded grey sky, no raking light.
notes.fix: Crouch at the toe so the crest runs diagonal against the low sun, light the crest, delete the clipped tree.

notes.problem: A clipped tree at the left edge, no elms, a thin stick on the face, uniform sprites.
notes.fix: Remove the off-screen tree, plant the elms, put the lath at the toe so its top lands on the crest, thin the sprites.

notes.problem: A generic grassy hill, the lath top above the crest, a cropped tree smudge at the left edge.
notes.fix: Pull back so the full profile sits against the sky, the lath at the toe meeting the crest, remove the left tree.

notes.problem: A thick black post, a flat ribbon, a dull grey sun, the stake behind the hook.
notes.fix: A rim highlight on the lath, cloth shading on the flagging, move the stake right of the hook.

notes.problem: A dull grey sun high in the frame, contour banding, flat flagging.
notes.fix: Put the sun in the low band, emissive with bloom, and shade the flagging with the backlight.

notes.problem: A flat black lath, a low-poly ribbon, rings around the sun, the stake behind the type.
notes.fix: Rim light and pine albedo on the lath, a soft cloth strip, deband the sky, shift the stake right of the type.

notes.problem: The pulled lath floats above its shadow and crosses the bottom wire.
notes.fix: Rest it on two ridges with a contact along its length, clear of the wire.

notes.problem: The pulled lath hovers at fence-wire height with its shadow detached.
notes.fix: Lower it onto the clay in the lower right foreground with a contact under its length.

notes.problem: Fog with no sky, flat squares, halos behind the furniture.
notes.fix: Cut the fog so a sky returns, long east shadows, seat the kicker on clean sky.

notes.problem: No horizon, a flat fog wall, squares that read as decals.
notes.fix: Cut the fog so the warm horizon band and tree line show, and give the squares raked texture with irregular edges.

notes.problem: Untextured clay, a mannequin, a banded grey sky.
notes.fix: Rake the low sun across the clay, turn the person and rim-light the shoulders, warm the sky.

notes.problem: No long shadows at a 7 degree sun, a mannequin person, sky arcs.
notes.fix: Cast long raking shadows east and rim-light the person.

notes.problem: No south line, FM 112, berm or houses, so the rows have no zero, one uniform corrugation.
notes.fix: Pitch down and back so FM 112, the fence and the berm sit in the bottom third.

notes.problem: A grey banded sky, no long cast from the lath, a dark-left lit-right split.
notes.fix: Angle the sun so the near lath's shadow runs across the clay and both halves share one light.
